title: Source Specification v1
description: Extraction specification for an InfoSource. Each InfoSource holds a source_specs list; all specs are evaluated against the same fetch group (the InfoSource URL's fetched bytes, not chained off primary extracted output). The first spec is the primary extraction strategy; additional specs are cross-check alternatives for selector-rot detection. All specs in a list must share a content-kind family (html_text: css|xpath|full_page). Every algorithm here reaches a co-core extractor that honours it; which media types honour it is the extractor's to say: css on HTML only, xpath on HTML and XML (HTML since co-core 0.38, cannobserv#557), full_page on anything, one line per item on an RSS or Atom root. regex is refused by co-core; jsonpath, which co-core 0.38 honours on JSON (cannobserv#354), waits on archiver#356. The URL is a separate InfoSource field, not part of this spec.
